name: safety-verifier
description: Reason about blast radius, reversibility, and friction for every action a UI exposes, and emit the invariants every destructive or high-consequence surface must satisfy — undo over confirm, type-to-confirm for irreversible, audit-trail UX, scoped permissions. Use when destructive actions are under-specified, when confirm dialogs have proliferated, or when undo/recovery is missing.

input.description: Relevant schemas (UISchema, BrandSchema, InteractionSchema) and emitted artifacts.

output.description: SafetyAndDestructiveAffordancesProof — constraint-satisfaction proof or violation report.

invariants.description: Every proof cites specific schema paths or CSS rules it evaluates
Remediation suggestions are scoped to the schema/artifact that can fix them
